export_rights.summary: FreshBooks' privacy policy grants the right to receive a portable copy of Personal Information transferable to another organization, and its GDPR article documents an account-data export right for EU citizens (requests via privacy@freshbooks.com, completed within 30 days). Vendor help docs document per-entity CSV/PDF export of the customer's own account data at any time; after cancellation the account stays accessible until the end of the billing cycle and data is stated to remain preserved for reactivation.

routes.how: Per-entity Download CSV buttons in the web UI, per the vendor 'How do I export my data?' article: Clients list downloads active and archived clients including secondary contacts as CSV; Invoices list 'Download CSV' downloads all active and archived invoices (invoices can also be exported as PDFs); Expenses export as CSV via the Expense report; Chart of Accounts via More Actions > Export Accounts downloads a CSV including active, archived, and deleted accounts (per selected currency).
gotchas: No single whole-account backup/export is documented in the current FreshBooks help center - export is per entity.
Chart of Accounts export is per selected currency.

routes.how: REST JSON API at api.freshbooks.com; accounting resources use paths of the form /accounting/account/{accountId}/invoices/invoices. Auth is OAuth 2.0 (create an app in the FreshBooks developer page for client id/secret, exchange authorization code for access token). Paginate with page/per_page; list responses include a pages object with total counts. Related data (e.g. invoice lines) must be requested explicitly with include[] parameters.
requires: OAuth 2.0 app (client id/secret) from the FreshBooks developer page
authorization grant by an account user
routes.rate_limits: No published daily cap; requests are rate-limited if too many calls are made in a short period and excess calls return HTTP 429 (exact numeric limits are not published). Pagination is silently capped at per_page=100.
gotchas: per_page values above 100 return exactly 100 results with no error or warning.
Two identifier types exist (accountId vs businessId); accounting endpoints use accountId.
Aggressive usage can lead to FreshBooks disabling the app.

routes.how: Reports section in the main navigation: open any report, then use 'Export for Excel' to download a CSV, or Print to save as PDF. Vendor docs state any report can be exported as CSV or PDF; Invoice Details and Expense reports serve as detailed line-level exports, and Payroll/Contractor Payment reports export payroll data for accounts using the FreshBooks Payroll add-on.
requires: FreshBooks Payroll add-on for payroll/contractor payment reports

routes.how: Export Expense Receipts feature: download all uploaded receipt images for a chosen time period; the file generates asynchronously and a 'Download here' link delivers a zipped folder. Each file in the zip is named Date-Amount-Category-Merchant-ExpenseID-FileType. Single receipts can be downloaded from an expense's thumbnail preview via the Download link.
gotchas: Documented only for expense/bill receipt images; no equivalent bulk export is documented for files attached to invoices.

routes.how: Reports > Audit Log report (tracks changes to invoices and expenses, filterable by client, change type, entity type, user, and date range). Top-right options include 'Export to CSV' to download the log and Print to save it as a PDF.
gotchas: Coverage starts only from invoice changes made May 24, 2024 and expense changes made September 11, 2024 onwards; earlier history is not shown.
Only invoice and expense changes are covered - it is not a full account activity log.

routes.how: Chart of Accounts: More Actions > Export Accounts downloads a CSV of all active, archived, and deleted accounts in the selected currency. This is the only configuration artifact with a documented export.
gotchas: No documented export of invoice templates, customized fields, or automation/workflow settings as restorable artifacts.

preservation_notes.attachments: Expense/bill receipt images bulk-export via 'Export Expense Receipts' as a zip (files named Date-Amount-Category-Merchant-ExpenseID-FileType); single receipts download from the expense thumbnail. No documented bulk export for attachments on invoices - verify in-tenant.
preservation_notes.audit_log: Audit Log report exports via 'Export to CSV' (or Print to PDF); documented coverage is limited to invoice changes from 2024-05-24 and expense changes from 2024-09-11 onward, and only invoice/expense entities. No further retention limit is documented.
preservation_notes.config_artifacts: Chart of Accounts exports as CSV (More Actions > Export Accounts, including deleted accounts). No documented export of templates, custom fields, or workflow/automation settings as restorable artifacts.

notes: All claims derive from search-engine summaries of the vendor pages listed in sources, not full-page reads (third-party-only claims were discarded). Honest unknowns: no whole-account/one-click full backup export is documented for current FreshBooks (per-entity exports only; the privacy/GDPR route via privacy@freshbooks.com is a personal-data portability request, not a documented tenant backup); no post-termination retrieval window is documented - vendor docs say data remains preserved after cancellation for reactivation, with no stated deadline; API numeric rate limits are deliberately unpublished (429 on excess); no documented API endpoint for downloading invoice PDFs or bulk-downloading attachments was found; time-entry and payment CSV exports beyond the Reports route were not confirmed from vendor docs.
research_caveats: freshbooks.com and support.freshbooks.com were egress-blocked for direct fetching in the research environment, so all claims derive from search-engine summaries of the cited vendor pages rather than full-page reads.
